name: Umkhuhlane (umkhuhlane)
tagline: Ukuphumla nini. Ubiza nini ugqirha wakho.

what_is_it.heading: Umkhuhlane ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Umkhuhlane lusulelo lwentsholongwane lwempumlo, umqala, kunye nemiphunga. Bundlongondlongo kakhulu kunomkhuhlane oqhelekileyo - umkhuhlane, iintlungu zomzimba, kunye nokudinwa kuza kwiiyure nje ezimbalwa.
paragraphs: Uninzi lwabantu abasempilweni luyachacha kwisithuba seveki ukuya kwiintsuku ezilishumi. Ingozi ikhona kwiingxaki - i-pneumonia, ukunyuka kwe-asthma okanye isifo senhliziyo, ukungabikho kwamanzi kubantu abadala kunye nabantwana abancinci. Bamalunga ne-11,000 abemi boMzantsi Afrika abasweleka ngenxa yeengxaki ezinxulumene nomkhuhlane minyaka le.

Umkhuhlane awuyongqele embi nje. Ingqele iza kancinci. Umkhuhlane uhlasela kwiiyure nje ezimbalwa - umkhuhlane ophezulu, ukhohlokhohlo olomileyo, izihlunu ezibuhlungu, intloko ebuhlungu, kunye nohlobo lokudinwa okukubeka ebhedini.

items.headline: Ixesha lonyaka
items.body: Ixesha lomkhuhlane eMzantsi Afrika liqala ngoMeyi ukuya kuSeptemba. Ugonywe ngoMatshi okanye ngoAprili.

items.headline: Usabulala
items.body: Malunga ne-11,000 laseMzantsi Afrika lokusweleka ngonyaka - ubukhulu becala ngenxa yeengxaki ezifana nenyumoniya, ingakumbi kubantu abadala kunye nabagula kakhulu.

items.headline: Isitofu sokugonya sasimahla
items.body: Amaqela asemngciphekweni omkhulu afumana izitofu zokugonya umkhuhlane simahla kwiiklinikhi - ngaphezulu kwama-65, abasetyhini abakhulelweyo, izifo ezingapheliyo, abasebenzi bezempilo.

items.headline: Phumla, hayi antibiotics
items.body: Abantu abadala abasempilweni badla ngokufuna ukuphumla, ulwelo kunye nexesha- hayi amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane. Ii-antibiotics azisebenzi ngokuchasene neentsholongwane.

pull_quote.text: Isitofu sokugonya somkhuhlane asinakukunika umkhuhlane-yenye yezona ntsomi zithe gqolo neziyingozi. Isitofu sokugonya asinayo intsholongwane ephilayo.

signs.heading: Umkhuhlane ngokuchasene nokubanda - ukuba uxela njani
signs.lede: Umkhuhlane kunye neengqele zizifo ezahlukeneyo. Ukwazi ukuba yintoni onayo kutshintsha into oyenzayo ngokulandelayo.

items.title: Umkhuhlane ubetha ngokukhawuleza nanzima
items.description: Ubushushu obuphezulu (ngaphezulu kwama-38°C) buvela kwiiyure nje ezingephi, umzimba oqaqanjelwayo, ukhohlokhohlo olomileyo, ukudinwa. Uziva ukhutshiwe.

items.title: Okubandayo kwakha kancinci
items.description: Impumlo evuzayo, umqala obuhlungu, ukudinwa kancinci. Uziva urhabaxa kodwa usebenza. Akukho fever ephezulu, akukho ntlungu yomzimba.

items.title: Iimpawu ezilumkisayo
items.description: Ubunzima bokuphefumla, iintlungu zesifuba, imilebe eluhlaza, ukugabha kakhulu, ukubhideka, iimpawu eziphucuka emva koko ziba mandundu-bonana nekliniki.

spreads.heading: Usasazeka njani umkhuhlane
yes: Ukukhohlela kunye nokuthimla kubantu abosulelekileyo - amathontsi ahamba malunga nemitha
Ukuchukumisa iindawo umntu owosulelekileyo akhohlele kuzo, aze achukumise ubuso bakho
Uqhagamshelwano olusondeleyo kwiindawo ezingenamoya omdaka - amagumbi okufundela, iiteksi, iiofisi
Ukusuka kumntu osulelekileyo ukuqala usuku ngaphambi kokuba azive egula
no: Ukubanda okanye ukumanzi - ukubanda akubangeli umkhuhlane, intsholongwane iyawenza
Isitofu sokugonya somkhuhlane — asiqulathanga ntsholongwane iphilayo

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuzikhusela wena nosapho lwakho
prevention.lede: Isitofu sokugonya somkhuhlane sonyaka yeyona nto isebenzayo. Nokuba usenawo umkhuhlane emva kokugonywa, ukholisa ukuba buthathaka kakhulu.

items.title: Isitofu sokugonya somkhuhlane sonyaka
items.description: Fumana ugonyo rhoqo ngonyaka phambi kwexesha lomkhuhlane. Ezikliniki zisimahla kumaqela asemngciphekweni omkhulu, malunga ne-R100 kwiikhemesti ezininzi kumntu wonke.

items.title: Hlamba izandla rhoqo
items.description: Isepha kunye namanzi imizuzwana engama-20, okanye i-alcohol sanitiser. Ingakumbi emva kwesithuthi sikawonke-wonke, ivenkile, okanye isithuthi sesikolo.

items.title: Ukungenisa umoya
items.description: Vula iifestile ezindlwini, kumagumbi okufundela, nakwiiofisi. Umkhuhlane usasazeka kancinci kwiindawo ezinomoya owaneleyo.

items.title: Hlala ekhaya ukuba uyagula
items.description: Ukuba unomkhuhlane, hlala ekhaya iiyure ezingama-24 emva kokuba umkhuhlane wakho ugqabhukile. Wosulela kakhulu kwiintsuku ezi-3-4 zokuqala.

items.fact: Isitofu sokugonya somkhuhlane asinayo intsholongwane ephilayo. Abanye abantu baziva bediniwe okanye banomkhuhlane ongephi emva kokudutyulwa - yi-immune system ephendulayo, hayi umkhuhlane.
Abantu abasempilweni bahlala besinda kumkhuhlane - kodwa bawusasaze kubantu abasesichengeni. Ugonyo lukhusela wena nabantwana bakho, abazali kunye noogxa bakho.

items.myth: Amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane aya kuwuphelisa umkhuhlane wam ngokukhawuleza.
items.fact: Ii-antibiotics zisebenza kuphela kwiibhaktheriya. Umkhuhlane yintsholongwane. Ukuthatha amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane ngokungeyomfuneko kuvelisa iibhaktheriya ezixhathisayo kwixesha elizayo.

items.myth: Nje ukuba ndibe neempawu, selidlulile ixesha kwisitofu sokugonya.
items.fact: Ukuba sele unomkhuhlane, isitofu sokugonya asiyi kunyanga eso siqendu - kodwa alikaze liphele ixesha lonyaka xa lilonke. Kudla ngokubakho ukutyhileka ngakumbi kamva.

items.title: Ukuphumla, ulwelo, iparacetamol
items.description: Lala kangangoko unako. Sela amanzi, ijusi, isuphu. I-Paracetamol okanye ibuprofen yomkhuhlane kunye neentlungu.

items.title: Musa ukucela amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane
items.description: Umkhuhlane yintsholongwane. Ii-antibiotics azenzi nto kwiintsholongwane. Ziyanceda kuphela xa kuvela ingxaki yebhaktiriya efana nenyumoniya.

items.title: Ukuba usengozini enkulu - bonana ekliniki kwangoko
items.description: Ngaba ukhulelwe, ngaphezu kweminyaka engama-65, ukugula okungapheliyo (isifuba, isifo sentliziyo, isifo seswekile, i-HIV)? Bona ikliniki kwiiyure ezingama-48 - ii-antivirals zisebenza ngcono kwangoko.

items.title: Jonga iimpawu ezilumkisayo
items.description: Ubunzima bokuphefumla, iintlungu zesifuba, ukubhideka, ukugabha kakhulu, ukuba mandundu ngokukhawuleza - fumana unyango.

items.title: Khusela abanye
items.description: Hlala ekhaya de ungabi namkhuhlane iiyure ezingama-24. Gquma ukhohlokhohlo ngengqiniba. Musa ukutyelela izalamane ezikhulileyo ngoxa ugula.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Uninzi lomkhuhlane unokulawulwa ekhaya. Iiklinikhi kunye neekhemesti zinceda ngeempawu ezinzima kunye namaqela asemngciphekweni omkhulu.

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Ikliniki nganye karhulumente inikezela ngezitofu zokugonya umkhuhlane simahla kumaqela asemngciphekweni omkhulu
